title: Saudi Arabian Fish Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic fish pilaf dish from Saudi Arabia, made with fresh fish, pilaf, and unique spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the fish and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the skillet and set aside.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with any remaining oil and spices.
Add the unique spice blend and Arabian coffee (if using) to the pilaf and stir to combine.
Return the fish to the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
